$comment: Monsieur Cuisine smart (MC3.0) automatic programs and recipe limits, in four layers. Maintained by hand; see the sources block.

sources.editor: Recipe editor on www.monsieur-cuisine.com, web app version 1.138.0. The program catalog is a static table per device in the page's JavaScript; no API call delivers modes or limits.
sources.server: Live probes on 2026-10-13 from a member account: 80 updates of a private draft, each changing one value. The server checks enumerations only; every out-of-range number was stored unchanged.
sources.assumed: SmartRecipe (MIT) limits in its mode converter and constants, as analysed on 2026-10-12.
sources.corpus: Numbers derived from 2,221 public MC3.0 recipes (1,094 official, 1,127 member). Official recipes are the reference.
sources.officialGuide: The official recipe-creation guide for members (speed 1-10, butterfly whisk at most speed 4, step description shown on the device for only two programs, drawn as icons that match scale and turbo).

layers.editor: What the website editor lets a member enter for MC3.0.
layers.server: What the recipe API did with probe values. null means not probed. rangeEnforced false means out-of-range numbers were stored unchanged.
layers.assumed: What SmartRecipe assumes. null means SmartRecipe does not support it.
layers.corpus: Observed values in public recipes, split into official and member.
layers.effective: What the bridge validator enforces: the editor limit, tightened where SmartRecipe, the official guide or official recipes give a stricter rule that no official recipe breaks. Editor minimums of 0 s are replaced by the smallest value in official recipes.

conditionFormat: Each condition is { when: { <param>: { <op>: value } }, set: { <field>: value }, kind }. Ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte. kind device = editor or device rule, accessory = depends on an attachment, sanity = enforced by the bridge only.
labels: label.de is the website's German label (our translation for MC4.0-only modes, which the site shows in English). label.en is our translation.
payloadRules: mode.type is the snake_case id; the editor uses camelCase internally.
deviceSettings is an array with one object per phase (one for every mode except ramp), keys as listed in payload.deviceSettingsKeys. Keys of device-controlled values are not sent.
cooking_eggs and precleaning send modeSetting instead of deviceSettings.
Unknown mode types are rejected with HTTP 400 code 40004.

deviceTables.note: The editor uses the first device in this order that the recipe lists.

tables.MC3.0: 19 programs, 2 of them editors only (kneading, ramp)
tables.MC2.0: kneading, steaming, roasting with free temperature 0-130 °C, scale, customized, turbo, ramp (editors only)
tables.MC1.1: like MC2.0 without ramp; kneading default 90 s
tables.MC0.5: kneading 45-90 s, roasting 100-130 °C, scale 1-3000 g, customized up to 5400 s with speed max 6 above 600 s, turbo without parameter
tables.MC4.0: half speeds, defaults for every program, attachments as modules, nine extra programs (see otherDeviceModes)
